observations: A single photo showing a high-end dining set.
Oval white marble-effect table top on a gold-colored pedestal base.
Six beige upholstered chairs with vertical stitching and gold-colored sled-style metal frames.
The image is a professional render or studio catalog photo, not a photo of an item in a domestic or warehouse setting.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI SAMINTERIORS' is visible across the center.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows a table with six chairs.
Comfort cannot be determined from a photo.

risks.risk: The photo is a professional render/stock image and does not show the actual item in the seller's possession.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual item in a real-world environment with a handwritten note showing the current date.

risks.risk: The table top may be faux marble or laminate rather than solid stone.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the table edge and the underside of the slab.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual item in its current location (not a catalog render).
Close-up of the table top edge to verify material.
Photo of the underside of the table and chair frames to check construction quality.
response.reason: The seller has provided a professional 3D render or catalog image instead of a photo of the actual item. In a second-hand market, the use of stock imagery is a primary indicator of a scam or a bait-and-switch.
